name: Ingenuity at Jezero
description: Ingenuity positions are estimated from observed 2D NASA/MMGIS paths and landing locations, with the official flight log constraining estimated altitude/time profiles. They are not complete 3D telemetry. Source, datum, clock, and frame uncertainty: data/ingenuity/reconstruction.json. Cube terrain and four independent imagery products are prepared locally; production publication requires authorization.

imagery.name: Global · Viking
imagery.description: Viking MDIM 2.1 color mosaic; nominal original 232 m, available service grid 325.61 m at equator

imagery.name: Global · CTX
imagery.description: Murray Lab CTX V01 global mosaic; nominal original 5 m, available service grid 5.0876 m at equator; original response gaps remain transparent

items.name: Ingenuity
items.description: Estimated flight reconstruction, not 3D telemetry. Horizontal paths and landings come from NASA/MMGIS observations; altitude and interior timing are modeled using NASA flight summaries and unchanged terrain. Absolute frame, height and clock accuracy remain uncertain.

provenance.limitations: Original MMGIS event epochs retained as approximate J2000 seconds; clock drift uncalibrated. Observed horizontal path with estimated 3D playback, not precise flight telemetry.
